confidence_notes: Current Hualien price indexes give a useful range for meals, coffee, and beer, though they differ somewhat on meal totals. Cocktail and wine estimates use their local price relationship to draft beer because citywide samples are sparse. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and may vary with season and tourism demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Hualien is a smaller eastern Taiwan tourism city. Basic rooms and hostel stays are estimated near the lower end of the supplied Taiwan comparisons, while three-star rooms are near Kenting and the lower end of Kaohsiung, allowing for Hualien's leisure demand.
